notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Zealous Conscripts.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding an amount of {B} equal to Zealous Conscripts's mana value.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.
